messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hybrid norms and upcoming offsites 9 drop any clarifying Qs here, we'll answer through EOD. :wave:
Priya (People Ops): TL;DR: weekly hub day baseline, managers can request a second day. Offsite request form and travel templates go live Thursday.
Zara (Eng): For multi-team offsites, who signs off on the agenda and headcount?
Maya (People Ops): Managers sign off on their team's attendees. For cross-team agendas, product/eng leads should align, People Ops helps coordinate logistics.
Omar (Finance): Budget guideline: $1,200 per person standard. If projected total >$6k, route to Finance for quick review.
Zara (Eng): Cancellation question: if we need to postpone within 10 days, who covers deposits?
Priya (People Ops): We try refundable bookings. For non-refundable deposits, cost falls to team budget unless exec-level change; People Ops keeps a small contingency for company-scheduled events.
Julian (CEO): One ask: when teams pick hub days, try to keep 2 core overlap days for cross-team collaboration. Not mandatory.
Zara (Eng): Visa letters? how early?
Maya (People Ops): Request visa/invitation letters at least 6 weeks before travel. Use the travel form so we can generate official letters.
Omar (Finance): Expense note: submit receipts in Expensely within 30 days. Childcare add-on reimbursable with pre-approval up to $300/day.
Priya (People Ops): We're piloting a coworking stipend in APAC: $150/month. Details in the FAQ on Thursday.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) publish Offsite & Travel FAQ + templates Thursday, 2) add 1-page risk/backup template, 3) publish desk-row reservation steps. Ping @Priya for urgent exceptions.
ops-bot: Thread closed for edits after 60 minutes (automated).
